PluginInfo.Name: PowerShell
PluginInfo.ShortDescription: Execute scripts or commands on Windows computers.
PluginInfo.Description:
Execute custom scripts or commands on one or more Windows computers.

Manage your PowerShell scripts in Royal TSX using the built-in script editor with syntax highlighting support. Replacement tokens can be passed on to your scripts using standard PowerShell script parameters.

General
  • Requires Royal Server
  • Execute PowerShell scripts on one or more computers
  • Automatically display the results in the dashboard
  • Configurable auto refresh
  • Edit PowerShell scripts in Royal TSX with syntax highlighting
  • Display the results in a grid
  • Display the results as text

Advanced Features
  • Configure script parameters (with replacement token support)
  • Test script execution
  • Customize text font, size and console color for text output
  • Quick search
  • Column filter
